The [[Grand Inquisitor/Legends|Grand Inquisitor]], [[Hydra (Grand Inquisitor)|Hydra]] owned a '''[[Blaster/Legends|blaster]]''' which she kept on her [[Utility belt/Legends|utility belt]]. While interrogating [[Clive Flax]], [[Astri Oddo]] stole the blaster and locked her in the detainment cell that Hydra was interrogating Clive in.<ref name="Reckoning" />
